v2_0_blockers.REPRODUCER: S1 tests: c2_p9 run() / main() with each profile refuses before any client call

v2_0_blockers.TITLE: the authoritative chained journal is removed with the run's temporary directory; an InvariantError (BaseException) or a refused shutdown skips the projection too
v2_0_blockers.REPRODUCER: S2 tests: normal, Exception, BaseException, refused shutdown and interrupted runs each leave the raw journal, hash chain verifiable
v2_0_blockers.AFFECTED_SHIPPED_PATH: run driver (c2_p9.run today; the S3 product runtime)

candidate == base/tip: git merge --no-ff makes no commit yet MERGED is reported at the tip; a post-merge failure then resets the branch to tip^1, removing the previous story's merge
v2_0_blockers.REPRODUCER: S2: prior story committed; next story candidate == base; simulated post-merge failure; previous story remains present
v2_0_blockers.source: review B7 (verified by reading workspace.py:123-160, story_runner.py:282-306)

v2_0_blockers.REPRODUCER: G6 check: pip install of the built wheel, then `aisef run` without the repository

v2_0_blockers.REPRODUCER: measured by the python_callable_v2 B1 lane on 27b3639 (a subject sends SIGSTOP to its parent and returns 1: blocks SUBJECT_DEADLINE SATISFIED); regression cases tests/v2/test_python_callable_v2.py::Forgery.test_PCV2_B1_BLOCKS_STOP_001_* and tests/v2/test_c2_cli_invocation.py::test_CLI_2b_B1_BLOCKS_STOP_001_*
v2_0_blockers.AFFECTED_SHIPPED_PATH: aisef2/probe/python_callable_v2.py, aisef2/probe/cli_invocation.py (_watch: the deadline read from the range's liveness)
v2_0_blockers.AFFECTED_V2_CLAIM: G5; candidate code must not control the verdict channel
v2_0_blockers.V2_0_DISPOSITION: BLOCK — fixed in 85ac8d3 (the controller's own timer writes the deadline RESULT) and completed in ec8e759 after the pre-RC implementation review measured the timer still armed through the closing exchange (IR-01): the race is settled when the observed operation answers

v2_0_blockers.V2_0_DISPOSITION: BLOCK — fixed in 5a8203b: RUN.json budget_stop is what the budget actually stopped (a story not started, a session refused or ended, spend past a ceiling, unaccounted spend)
